description: Nowind type: a fluid Utopia scale with Tailwind/Prewind names. Each size is a clamp() from its size at the minimum viewport to its size at the maximum, so it grows with the viewport without media queries.
method: Tailwind v4's scale on a Utopia base: size(step) = Tailwind's fraction × base, where base is fluid (minBase at minVw to maxBase at maxVw, interpolated linearly in vw). The fractions are xs 0.75, sm 0.875, base 1, lg 1.125, xl 1.25, 2xl 1.5, 3xl 1.875, 4xl 2.25, 5xl 3, 6xl 3.75, with Tailwind's line heights; at a 16px base every step is Tailwind's exactly, and the whole scale grows with the viewport, the root size and the tier.

naming.sizes: Tailwind v4 / Prewind: --text-xs … --text-6xl. base is step 0.
naming.tracking: Tailwind v4 names; values differ: tight is -0.01em (Tailwind -0.025em), widest 0.16em (Tailwind 0.1em).

kicker.rule: A kicker is 0.92 × the size it sits beside, never under 9px, so uppercase mono reads at that size's weight.
kicker.use: Set together: font-family, font-weight, letter-spacing, text-transform, font-size --kicker-{size}, color --fg-weak.

faces.use: Body face: Inter, loaded from Google Fonts by theme.css (variable, 400–700, with optical sizes and italics).
Headings and display: Inter Tight, 500–800, loaded by theme.css.
Display figures and numerals (prices, metrics): Inter Tight, the face that carries 800. Pair with font-extrabold and tracking-tight.
Kicker, code and figures: IBM Plex Mono 400 and 500, loaded by theme.css.

notes: Sizes are viewport-fluid. Inside a tier each step grows by the tier's text step (--tier-text: 2px content, 4px brand) times the step's Tailwind fraction, so the whole scale grows with the tier's body size. A .scope with its own font-size does not resize them.

The vw part is --vw: 1vw scaled by the root size over 16px (calc(1vw * (1rem / 16px)), CSS typed arithmetic), so the whole clamp scales with the root font size: a 12px root gives exactly 0.75 of every size at 16px, at any width. Browsers without typed arithmetic keep plain 1vw, where the vw part does not follow the root or zoom; keep maxBase / minBase under about 2.5 (WCAG 1.4.4).
